svg.title: Qwen vs Nanbeige: saved first-text, prompt-time, decode and wall-time p50/p95
svg.desc: Four zero-based paired-bar panels, Qwen then Nanbeige within EQ and retail. First-text and server prompt seconds, native tokens/second, and complete-call seconds. Sample counts shown per metric; tool-only first text stays missing, capped failure is retained separately. Non-matched tokenizers/cache/order; no audible latency or new inference measured.
